boundary: same single KV owner, same total physical capacity and reference hardware boundary
measured_inputs: logical scratch traffic and exponent/replay counts
charged peak allocation and retained set

unknown_physical_parameters.A_base: reference owner area in a selected process; positive, not supplied
unknown_physical_parameters.delta_A_macro: area change from reorganization/access of existing accumulator macros; capacity equality does not prove zero macro overhead
unknown_physical_parameters.w_select_mac: number of routed accumulator datapath bits; layout-dependent, not inferred from 8 KiB capacity
unknown_physical_parameters.w_select_read: number of routed readout datapath bits; layout-dependent
unknown_physical_parameters.a_mux_bit: area per selected mux bit in the selected library
unknown_physical_parameters.delta_A_control: selector/controller implementation area after state aliasing, including command-selection encoding/decoding and any request-control state
unknown_physical_parameters.delta_A_route: routing/buffering/port-access area determined by physical design
unknown_physical_parameters.P_base: total reference average owner power in watts, not supplied
unknown_physical_parameters.delta_P_average: total candidate average-power change, including all cache/spill/control activity and leakage; not just power of added logic
unknown_physical_parameters.calibration: disjoint command/scratch/EPU energy weights or device-level average-power measurement; no coefficient values assumed

area_equation: delta_A = delta_A_macro + w_select_mac*a_mux_bit + w_select_read*a_mux_bit + delta_A_control + delta_A_route; any separately added storage must be added explicitly
statistics: Uniform overhead across a cohort permits the GM S budget. An all-context improvement uses min(S); neither criterion guarantees every query. Negative budgets mean no positive overhead can satisfy strict improvement.

capacity_accounting.accumulator_payload: existing 8192 B budget organized as two selectable 4096 B arrays; modeled routing extension, not stock hardware
capacity_accounting.transient_descriptor: 64 B alias of the released producer window; no producer/consumer overlap
capacity_accounting.predictor: 64 B persistent charge before retention; seven argmax and seven length uint32 entries (56 B), valid byte and padding (8 B)
capacity_accounting.exponent_cache: 4N B, plus 4*ceil(N/16) B group sums and ceil(ceil(N/16)/8) B validity; charged before selecting S
capacity_accounting.shadow_control: same charged unused cache bytes and retained set, without functional exponent reuse
capacity_accounting.capacity_sensitivity: 384/512 KiB applied to both arms. It is additional hardware capacity, never an area-neutral claim.

implementation_scope: Native fixture guard limits H<=7, D<=128, Q<=2048 and N<=16384. Host trace vectors/counters are validation instrumentation, not free simultaneous device payload.
timing_caveat: MAC7/8 sensitivity changes callback completion plus matching controller service, retaining native column rules. Candidate-only MAC+1 is a separate routing penalty. Neither is a synthesized clock-frequency estimate. Bank selection is a modeled per-command extension with no added column commands; its physical encoding/control interface must be implemented. The trace auditor does not prove stock-device opcode availability or cover an implementation that needs extra commands.
activity_caveat: activity_delta.csv is an auditable feature basis, not joules. Calibrate non-overlapping energy terms before forming a power model; do not charge complete MAC-command energy and the same MAC operations twice.
